listing.name: Alien Trilogy — PSX-Trilogy-Recomp (LevonFrench)
listing.summary: Experimental project. Experimental hybrid with overlay fallback. Physical mouse input and a full playthrough have not been confirmed; Results from related games do not establish that this one works. These are the project’s reports; See below for original-file requirements and setup. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA SLUS00007 or PAL SLES00101 Alien Trilogy disc. The importer checks its exact CRC and boot SHA256, but does not verify every overlay or audio file. Keep your original game files separately. The recorded source review did not download or run the game.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the advertised v0.2.0 package’s Play.cmd and DISCS setup with your own disc. Keep the separate alien and alien-pal runtimes, settings and cards with their matching editions. A local source build is also available. Portcove does not manage this download and has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

warnings: This experimental hybrid retains overlay fallback. Physical mouse input and a full playthrough have not been confirmed. Results from related games do not establish that this one works. These are the project’s reports; Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
